name: sh.rowsafe/rowsafe
title: Rowsafe
description: PostgreSQL backups and a safety net for AI agents: check recoverability, set restore points.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Without it, your AI app signs in with Rowsafe (OAuth 2.1): you approve it in the Rowsafe dashboard and it can read your databases' health, backups and recommendations, and save Marks if you allow. For clients without OAuth, send a Rowsafe API key instead.
